actionConfiguration.body:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (post_id) post_id, likes_count, comments_count
  FROM sl_post_metrics
  ORDER BY post_id, fetched_at DESC
)
SELECT t.platform,
       p.content_text,
       p.post_url,
       p.published_at,
       l.likes_count::bigint AS reacciones,
       l.comments_count::bigint AS comentarios
FROM sl_social_posts p
JOIN sl_monitored_targets t ON t.id = p.target_id
JOIN latest l ON l.post_id = p.id
ORDER BY l.likes_count DESC
LIMIT 5;
